method: Independent native visual/artifact review of the exact three indexed projections, 12 distance-corner cases, five owl alignment cases, 72-state contact sheet, product render, shadow-sweep JSON, and modeled setup cues.
acceptance: Rabbit, fox, and owl must each be unmistakable without relying on captions in the exact indexed projections and throughout every tested distance case.
Alignment evidence must challenge all three indexed animals at centered and plus-or-minus two-degree yaw and pitch, or explicitly fail incomplete coverage.
The 5-degree cycle must truthfully expose the complete transition rather than imply an untested continuous animal morph.
A unique rabbit reset pointer and phone-facing or beam-direction cue must be visually discoverable from modeled setup cues and a setup-side view.
No human recognition, delight, room-light, finite-emitter, or physical-use claim may be inferred from digital evidence.
